items.q: Like what they call the king of the jungle, you know. Who was it went out there -- Frank and Buck -- Frank Buck and his wife -- Mr. and Mrs. Frank Buck -- right?

ctx.x: call them? A baron -- you know, like a single person -- a single man, you know -- what do they call that?

A single man?
Bachelor -- bachelor, see, now, he could pass by all kinds of -- you know, pedigrees of animals or species, you know, but they only want the bachelors, you see. They want to get the certain kind of bachelor, you see. Like what they call the king of the jungle, you know. Who was it went out there -- Frank and Buck -- Frank Buck and his wife -- Mr. and Mrs. Frank Buck -- right? Bring them back alive, you see. That's what they used to do. They used to go out in Clyde Beatty, you see -- he had, I think,…
Are you trying to say that tap dancing was the bachelor that one was looking for and couldn't find?
